__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing on the plains. This is a vast desolate place where the
wind can howl undisturbed since nothing but you bars its way. However you
are not the first to wander here. Before you somebody has left a small path.
The path looks rather bewildered and is not the kind of path to lead to
anywhere significant or important but it seems to have made up its mind to
enter the hills far away north.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Plains

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are strolling along a pleasant, shady lane. The road is lined on both
sides by tall, stately trees which lend the scene with a sense of quiet
serenity. You can follow the road north or south.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Lane

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here, the great eastern road intersects with an older road between the mines
of Moria and the ruined city of Thalos.  The outskirts of Midgaard lie to your
west, and the highway continues the the east.  An old northern road leads to
the dwarven kingdom and the abandoned mines of Moria, while the southern road
shows the scars of the war which destroyed Thalos.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: An old road leads towards the abandoned mines of Moria and the Dwarven Kingom.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3502 to 3501

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road continues east, where you hear faint singing.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3502 to 3525

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A once mighty road leads through the dwarf forest towards ruined Thalos.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3502 to 5261

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road leads west towards Midgaard.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3502 to 3503

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Cross Roads

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on the outskirts of a large city - Midgaard; the capital of this
land. The road leads east into the peace and quiet - and dangers - of the
forest; and to the west it becomes the main street of the town; surrounded by
a confusion of shops, bars, and market places.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: City Entrance

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a light forest. A path leads south, but the passage to the
east is easy enough. To the west, smoke can be seen rising above the
treetops. The sprawl of Midgaard lies north of here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the north, you see the southern gates of Midgaard.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3505 to 3256

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: More light forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3505 to 3506

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: This path cuts through the darkness of the Miden'nir.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3505 to 3507

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Woodsman's Inn.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3505 to 3570

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Trail to Miden'nir

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a dark forest. To the east, mountains block passage. From
here, only the lighter forest to the west or south offer a way to travel.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The forest is darker to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3506 to 3509

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The forest gets lighter as you go west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3506 to 3505

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Miden'nir

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The forest is deep here and the wind blows through the trees and
through your hair. To the north, the forest gets lighter. However, the
southern and western paths place you even deeper in the wood.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The forest is lighter in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3507 to 3505

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: More and darker woods.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3507 to 3510

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a small path leading west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3507 to 3508

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Miden'nir

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A path is here, leading east and south through the dark woods of
Miden'nir. Mountains slash the scenery to the west of here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Wind-swept forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3508 to 3507

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south, the trail continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3508 to 3511

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On a Small Path

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The trees of Miden'nir are lush and green, hiding the evil that lurks
in these woods. The trees become too thick to the west, but you may go
north, south or travel toward the mountains that lie east of here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trees lighten up a bit this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3509 to 3506

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Huge grey mountains lie in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3509 to 3512

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The forest continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3509 to 3514

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Miden'nir

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here footworn paths meet leading north, south and east. The trees seem to
be closing in on you at this point, and you can barely see the sky
through the thick branches above your head.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Trees as far as the eye can see.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3510 to 3507

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is an especially dark part of the forest this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3510 to 3514

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is an especially dark section of forest this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3510 to 3516

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Crossroads

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a north-south trail through the woods. To the west, impassable
mountains glare at you, and the thick woods and undergrowth prevent any
movement westward.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trail bends to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3511 to 3508

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south, the path re-enters the forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3511 to 3515

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Trail

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The trees of Miden'nir are lush and green, hiding the evil that lurks
in these woods. You can go north toward the mountains, or west to the
forest, but the steep mountains prevent any movement east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A light section of forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3512 to 3513

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The forest continues here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3512 to 3509

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Miden'nir

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The forest is dark, and becomes even darker west.  You sense
that there is something evil hidden in these woods.  The forest gets
lighter to the north.  The wind kicks up as you ponder your options.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a small clearing to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3513 to 3512

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It gets darker and thicker this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3513 to 3514

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Miden'nir

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
It is quite dark here, forest surrounds you. With each step, the forest
seems to close around you, and get darker and more foreboding.  It might just
be time to head back to somewhere safe.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: More forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3514 to 3509

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Lighter forest and mountains in the distance.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3514 to 3513

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: More trees.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3514 to 3517

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The forest continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3514 to 3510

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Deep Forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The forest is light here and you can easily pick your way through the
trail.  To the east, the forest becomes thick and darker. South, the trail
continues.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A trail leading north-south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3515 to 3511

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trees get thicker as you go east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3515 to 3516

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: More trees and some small hills.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3515 to 3518

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Light Forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The ground is quite muddy here and puddles are all around. Your boots
make a disgusting SQUISH as you walk here. You can go in any of the
four cardinal directions from here. Hopefully, it will be dryer.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Miden'nir continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3516 to 3510

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: More trees.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3516 to 3517

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trees get VERY thick to the south. You can barely see...
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3516 to 3519

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Some light trees and daylight.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3516 to 3515

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Muddy Ground

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The most prominent feature here is the mountains that lie to the east.
You can only go north and west from here as the rocks stop all other
movement.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Many trees to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3517 to 3514

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a bit of a slope downward to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3517 to 3516

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Near the Mountains

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The trail becomes nearly unpassable here. You can go north
as the forest is relatively light. To the south, you can see a path.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You can see a trail this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3518 to 3515

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trees are nearly trunk-to-trunk this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3518 to -1

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Dark forests.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3518 to 3522

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Fading Trail

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are hemmed in by trees on either side of you.  The path
continues north and south, and while is much to thick to explore west,
you can head off into the woods to the east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The forest gets lighter this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3519 to 3516

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The forest continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3519 to 3520

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a strong stench coming from this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3519 to 3521

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trees are nearly trunk-to-trunk this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3519 to -1

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Dark Path

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stomp your way through the underbrush.  The dark forest of Miden'nir
get pretty thick here, and the branches high above your head are so thick that
they block out all direct sunlight.  While it is much too thick to go
further east, you might be able to make your way though the forest to the
south and west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The thick forest continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3520 to 3523

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The thick forest continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3520 to 3519

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Dark Forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here, you see a gruesome sight. Blood is everywhere... on the trees and
soaked into the ground. Two carcasses lie in front of you, seeming to look
up at you. The forest is impassible to the south, but the other directions
look ok.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Darkness...
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3521 to 3519

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Your light does not extend that far.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3521 to 3523

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: More dark forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3521 to 3522

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The corpses looked as if they have been pierced by a large, jagged
spear. The damage these people sustained is simply amazing. Worse, the
lips on the bodies are a light shade of blue, hinting at poison in
their systems.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.keyword: carcass body corpse carcasses bodies corpses

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Carnage

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
There is a sickening stench here. It smells of blood and death.
To the north, you catch glimpses of daylight. To the east, you
simply cannot see. The trees are close and stifling.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see daylight and a trail to follow.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3522 to 3518

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The stench seems to becoming from this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3522 to 3521

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Deep in the Forest of Miden'nir

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The branches above you block out all direct sunlight, making the forest
in this area rather dark.  The forest continues east, where it meets the
mountains. The air is still and stuffy - a stench comes from the west and an
ugly feeling causes the hair to rise on the back of your neck!

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It appears to get much darker that direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3523 to 3520

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The sky becomes lighter in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3523 to 3521

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Dark Forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are walking along a well-travelled road between Midgaard and lands
east.  A northern road crosses this one to the west, towards Midgaard.  You
hear faint, happy singing to the north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a faint trail, covered with tiny footprints. The singing grows louder.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3525 to 101

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road continues to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3525 to 3526

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You can see the crossroads.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3525 to 3502

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Along the Eastern Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are travelling down the eastern road between Midgaard and the eastern
lands.  The road back to Midgaard is west of you, and a heavily guarded
checkpoint is east.  A beautiful grove of trees is north, and a dirt path
wanders off to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a beautiful, shady grove -- it looks like a peaceful place to relax.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3526 to 8950

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road continues west towards a guarded checkpoint.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3526 to 3527

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A dirt path leads to the gnome village.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3526 to 1501

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road continues west towards midgaard.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3526 to 3525

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Along the Eastern Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are met by a group of heavily armored knights.  They check you over
for contraband, and then allow you to pass on.  One of the knights cautions to
not stray into the desert, lest you lose your way.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The continues east towards New Thalos.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3527 to 3528

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road continues west towards midgaard.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3527 to 3526

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Checkpoint

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are walking along a well-travelled road, just east of a heavily
guarded checkpoint.  You have covered about half the distance between
the city of Midgaard and New Thalos.  The air is getting drier and the heat
more oppressive as you near the the barren wastes of the Sands of Sorrow.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road continues ahead, growing more arid as you near the desert.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3528 to 3529

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a heavily guarded checkpoint to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3528 to 3527

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Along the Eastern Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The tempatures are climbing as you near the Sands of Sorrow, a barren
wasteland blasted by arcane powers.  Ahead of you, the road is partially
buried by the creeping sands, and the air grows even hotter.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the Sands of Sorrow spilling over the road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3529 to 3530

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road continues to the west, towards distant Midgaard.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3529 to 3528

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Along the Eastern Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The eastern road is losing ground to the creeping desert here.  You stagger
in the growing heat, and wonder if you have enough water.  The endless waste
of the Sands of Sorrows is south, and the road continues east and west.  The
sun paints illusions at the edge of your vision, one of them looks like a far
off city...

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road ahead is almost lost in the desert.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3530 to 3531

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a clearer section of road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3530 to 3529

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Near the Sands of Sorrow

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The road is almost completely swallowed by the desert here.  The heat is
sucking the life from your body, you wonder if it will ever end.  To your
south, the Sands of Sorrow stretch on for miles, and to the east you think
you see the towers of a magnificent city...or is it just a mirage?

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You can barely make out enough road to follow.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3531 to 3532

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The desert thins a little to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3531 to 3530

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Near the Sands of Sorrow

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The sun is hot enough to melt your armor, but salvation is at hand.  To the
east, you see the mighty gates of New Thalos, one of the most prosperous cities
of all of Thera.  To the south, you see the endless wasteland of the Sands
of Sorrows, and to the west you can barely make out a faint, but well-used,
road leading to the City of Midgaard.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the west gate of New Thalos.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3532 to 9669

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the road to Midgaard, covered with sand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3532 to 3531

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On the Outskirts of New Thalos

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You find yourself at the foot of the mountains, where it is much to steep
to continue north or east.  You see the lush, green forest of Miden'nir to the
south and west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The forest of Miden'nir spreads out before you.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3550 to 3512

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The forest of Miden'nir spreads out before you.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3550 to 3506

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: At The Foot of The Mountains

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The branches above you block out all direct sunlight, making the forest
in this area very dark.  The forest continues west, but mountains block
further exploration in all other directions, except south, where you notice a
small tunnel dug into the mountainside.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Deep in the Forest of Miden'nir

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The walls of this tunnel were carved out many years ago by the goblins of
this forest.  The floor is well worn, and continues south, into the
mountain, or back north out into the forest.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Outside, you see the forest of Miden'nir.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3552 to 3551

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The tunnel continues to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3552 to 3553

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Tunnel in the Mountains

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The tunnel gets lighter to the north, presumably leading out, while to
the south the passage gets smaller and smaller.  A small alcove has been
carved into the east wall.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The tunnel gets wider in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3553 to 3552

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small alcove.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3553 to 3554

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The tunnel gets smaller in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3553 to 3555

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Tunnel in the Mountains

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A small alcove has been carved out here.  There are a bunch of twigs
and leaves thrown into a pile here, probably serving as a bed.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the main passageway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3554 to 3553

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The twigs and leaves have all been piled together as a makeshift bed for
some small humanoid.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Small Alcove

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
As you explore further into the mountainside, the tunnel gets smaller and
smaller to the south.  You almost have to hunch over to make your way thru
this area.  A small archway to the south leads into a large chamber.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The tunnel continues north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3555 to 3553

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small cavern.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3555 to 3556

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Tunnel in the Mountains

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The tunnel widens into a large (well, large for goblins) cavern that
serves as the living quarters for the goblins of Miden'nir.  The bones of
numbers woodland creatures are strewn about the room, the remanents of a
recent meal.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The tunnel heads north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3556 to 3555

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Goblin Headquarters

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing on a well-worn path which opens into a clearing.
An old, wooden building is here with smoke billowing from its
chimney. A painted sign is visible on the porch to the west. You
could go north or south around the building or leave this place and
return to the forest.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You can go north around the inn.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3570 to 3571

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Back through the trees to the Miden'nir.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3570 to 3505

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You can go south around the inn.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3570 to 3572

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The front door of the inn beckons.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3570 to 3574

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Front of the Inn

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing north of the inn. Things don't look much different
from this angle.  The air here is filled with smells of smoke and cooking.
South, the front porch is waiting for you... or you can see if there is
a back door.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the front of the Inn.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3571 to 3570

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: North of the Inn

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing south of the inn.  You could easily go north and enter
through the front door, or west and to the rear of the establishment.  You
here some muffled cries from a tiny trail leading south of here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: This way leads to the front of the inn.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3572 to 3570

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trail heads south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3572 to 3575

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: This way leads to the back of the inn.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3572 to 3573

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: South of the Inn

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You now stand behind the inn. The smell here is not so pleasant as
the keeper and his help throw a good deal of garbage here. A couple of
piles of rubbish are to the west, but you will smell the worse for
meddling there. As a clean alternative, you can go north or east around
the inn.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You can go around the inn this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3573 to 3572

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Only rats and fool adventurers play in garbage.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3573 to 3578

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Behind the Inn

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the common room of the Woodsman Inn. A thin haze of smoke sits
in the air here. The Inn is often empty, as the forest has become overrun by
goblins as of late, and it is no longer safe in these parts. The bar is just
north of here. If you'd rather have your own table, one is empty to the
south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The bar is here, manned by the innkeeper.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3574 to 3576

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You can leave now and return to fresher air.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3574 to 3570

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: An empty table is a rare commodity.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3574 to 3579

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Woodsman Inn

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This is a overgrown foot-trail south of the inn. It leads west, but you
would be hard pressed to follow it far. A number of bushes are trampled on
and some medium sized branches have been knocked down.  Obviously there has
been a battle here rather recently.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The inn lies to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3575 to 3572

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A trail thru the woods.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3575 to 3581

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Ambush Point

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This is where people use to come and enjoy the food, drink and hospitality
of the innkeeper, but as of late, he only serves the few adventurers that
manage to survive a trip thru the forest. You can leave south and return to the
common room.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You may retreat south back to the common room.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3576 to 3574

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Bar

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a darker corner in the Inn.  A large round table with a few
wooden chairs sits here.  There is a large stain on the table, the remnants
of a spilled drink.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the main floor of the Inn to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3577 to 3574

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Bard's Table

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand knee deep in garbage.  YECCH!!! It smells terrible and who knows
what vermin live in these piles of filth ...

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You can return to cleaner lands this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3578 to 3573

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Garbage dump

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
There seems to be no one in this end of the Woodsman, probably a safe place
to rest and lick your wounds ...

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the common room.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3579 to 3574

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Quieter Section of the Inn

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The path continues east and west of here.  You notice fresh tracks in
the soft ground that show the horsemen fled to the west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Back to ambush point.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3581 to 3575

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trail continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3581 to 3582

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On the Trail of the Horsemen

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The path continues east and south.  You notice fresh tracks in
the soft ground that show the horsemen turned, and fled south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trail continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3582 to 3581

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The tracks lead south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3582 to 3583

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On the Trail of the Horsemen

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The trail of the horsemen continues east and north along this path through
the forest.  The tracks are still fresh, so they must be near.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trail continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3583 to 3582

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The tracks lead east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3583 to 3584

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On the Trail of the Horsemen

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The path comes to an abrupt end here, as the trees close around you and
make any further exploration impossible.  Fresh tracks cover the ground, and
end right here.  The horsemen must be nearby.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Back to along the trail.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  3584 to 3583

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Dead End Trail
